description: This file defines an Android service class 'SyncNotificationsService' that extends FirebaseMessagingService to handle incoming Firebase Cloud Messaging notifications related to synchronization events. It uses dependency injection to obtain a SyncManager instance and triggers synchronization requests when messages are received on a specific topic.

classes.name: SyncNotificationsService
classes.description: An Android service extending FirebaseMessagingService that listens for Firebase Cloud Messages on a specific topic and initiates synchronization through SyncManager when a message is received from the '/topics/sync' topic.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Overrides the FirebaseMessagingService method to handle incoming messages. If the message's sender matches the predefined sync topic, it requests a sync via SyncManager.
